name: Green Cabinets NY
subtitle: Custom cabinets in AR + scan
promotionalText: Scan your kitchen with your iPhone and send Green Cabinets the measured room. We plan your custom cabinets from the real walls and reply within 24 hours.
description:
Custom kitchen cabinets, vanities, closets and millwork for New York homes, designed in Bushwick since 2009.

CABINETS IN YOUR ROOM, IN AR
Stand in your kitchen and place real-size cabinets with the camera: base, drawer, wall and pantry cabinets. Drag them into place, line up a run, and switch every door between oak, walnut and painted finishes. Take pictures and send them to us. Works on any recent iPhone or iPad.

MEASURE WITH THE CAMERA
A tape measure in your camera for walls, gaps and windows, in feet and inches, inches or centimeters. Pictures keep the lengths written on them.

SCAN YOUR DRAWINGS
Architect's plans, a building floor plan or a sketch on paper: the scanner finds the page, straightens it and sends it for a price.

SCAN THE WHOLE ROOM
On an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR, walk your kitchen for about two minutes. The app measures every wall, door, window and existing cabinet, then shows the room in 3D. Read it as a floor plan with every size, and pick single walls to send as flat drawings. Every picture carries the Green Cabinets name and your scan's reference.

SEE THE WORK
Kitchens, vanities, walk-in closets and built-ins from Brooklyn, Manhattan and Queens. Pinch to look closer and ask about any look you like.

REAL PRICES UP FRONT
What NYC kitchens cost with us, by size, before the first visit.

BUILT FOR NEW YORK BUILDINGS
Co-op and condo paperwork, certificates of insurance, freight elevators, quiet hours, crooked pre-war walls. We plan around your building from day one.

MATERIALS
Compare 14 hardwoods by hardness, cost and stability, browse panel decors and paint colors, and see any of them on cabinets in your own room.

By appointment only. We bring door and finish samples to your home in Brooklyn, Manhattan and Queens.
reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing Green Cabinets NY. Following your 4.2 feedback we rebuilt the app from scratch as a fully native SwiftUI app. There is no web view anywhere in it.

Green Cabinets NY designs and installs custom kitchen cabinets in New York. The app is how clients plan a project from their own room. Everything below works on any recent iPhone or iPad, including devices without LiDAR.

TABS
Home: our work, the tools, real prices, how a project runs, and building rules for New York co-ops and condos.
Our work: a photo gallery with native zoom transitions, pinch to zoom and swipe between photos.
Plan: the native tools (below).
Materials: 14 wood species and our panel and paint finishes, each with "See it in your room" in AR.
Quote: a native form that sends the request, with everything made in the tools attached.

NATIVE TOOLS (Plan tab)
1. Cabinets in your room (ARKit + RealityKit): tap "Open the camera", move over the floor, tap the floor to place a real-size cabinet. Drag to move, rotate with two fingers, "Add next" lines up a run, the round chips change the finish. The shutter takes pictures; Done adds them to the quote.
2. Measure with the camera (ARKit raycasting): point the ring at one end of a wall, tap +, move to the other end, tap + again.
3. Scan the whole room (RoomPlan, LiDAR devices). On devices without LiDAR, "See a sample scan" opens the same native result screen: the room in 3D (SceneKit; drag to turn, pinch to zoom, "Select walls" then tap walls) and a floor plan drawn natively with every size.
4. Scan your drawings (VisionKit document camera).

Requests are emailed to our office. There are no accounts, sign-in, purchases or ads. The camera is used only for these tools.

Contact: orders@greencabinetsny.com, (718) 804-5488.
